# LearnPro

> > LearnPro is a comprehensive civil services exam preparation platform focused on UPSC and JPSC, offering editorial analysis, current affairs coverage, and optional subject coaching with emphasis on Indian governance, international relations, and regional studies.

LearnPro Civil Services provides in-depth analysis of contemporary issues, policy debates, and governance challenges crucial for UPSC aspirants. The platform covers editorial analysis on topics ranging from AI governance and fiscal federalism to tribal rights and parliamentary reforms, alongside specialized JPSC preparation materials on Jharkhand's economy, culture, and resources.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Preparation
- Editorial Analysis
- Indian Constitution & Polity
- JPSC Notes
- AI Governance & Digital Public Infrastructure
- International Relations (India-Israel, IMEC)
- Fiscal Federalism & Finance Commission
- Tribal Culture & Forest Rights Act
- Jharkhand Economy & Mineral Resources
- Parliamentary Oversight & Reforms
- Women's Labour & Inclusive Growth
- National Security & Defence Cooperation
- Environmental Ecology & Carbon Markets
- Digital Education & NEP 2020
- Agricultural Cooperatives & Rural Development

## UPSC Editorial Analysis

- [India's AI Revolution | UPSC Current Affairs](https://learnpro.in/indias-ai-revolution): UPSC current affairs on India's AI ecosystem, IndiaAI Mission & governance
- [Rewriting India's Developmental Trajectory through AI](https://learnpro.in/rewriting-indias-developmental-trajectory-through-ai-27-feb-2026-editorial-mm9d3ah3): Editorial on AI governance, NITI Aayog's AI strategy & inclusive development
- [Need For National Security Doctrine in India](https://learnpro.in/need-for-national-security-doctrine-in-india): National security doctrine necessity, Operation Sindoor & defense coordination
- [Future of the India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)](https://learnpro.in/future-of-the-indiamiddle-easteurope-economic-corridor-imec): IMEC corridor analysis on connectivity diplomacy & India's trade routes strategy
- [India–Israel Ties- From Tactical Engagement to Structural Partnership](https://learnpro.in/indiaisrael-ties-from-tactical-engagement-to-structural-pa-28-feb-2026): India-Israel bilateral relations, defence cooperation & strategic partnership
- [Strengthening Parliamentary Oversight in India](https://learnpro.in/strengthening-parliamentary-oversight-in-india): Parliamentary oversight challenges, executive dominance & accountability reforms
- [Reevaluating Speaker's Office: Impartiality & Reforms](https://learnpro.in/reevaluating-the-office-of-the-speaker): Speaker's role in Parliament, anti-defection law & constitutional reforms

## Governance & Policy Analysis

- [Sixteenth Finance Commission — misses and concerns](https://learnpro.in/sixteenth-finance-commission-misses-and-concerns): 16th Finance Commission analysis on fiscal federalism & tax devolution issues
- [Call for Permanent Settlement for Tribals](https://learnpro.in/call-for-permanent-settlement-for-tribals): Editorial on tribal displacement, Forest Rights Act & constitutional safeguards
- [Women's Labour & Issues of Recognition](https://learnpro.in/womens-labour-and-issues-of-recognition): Editorial on women's unpaid care work, labour force participation & GDP impact
- [Digital Push in Classrooms](https://learnpro.in/digital-push-in-classrooms): NEP 2020 digital education, digital divide & classroom technology challenges
- [Row over Selecting Head of Police Force in T.N.](https://learnpro.in/row-over-selecting-head-of-police-force-in-tn): Tamil Nadu DGP appointment controversy & UPSC empanelment process analysis
